# https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation

> This documentation provides comprehensive guidance on using the Symfony JSON Schema Validation bundle for robust data validation in APIs. It covers installation, configuration, API reference, examples of usage, and detailed explanations of its core principles and features like DTO injection and OpenAPI integration. The content aims to empower developers with a clear understanding of how to leverage this powerful tool for building reliable and type-safe applications.

## Pages

- [Documentation Setup | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/README.html): This documentation provides setup instructions and API reference for the Symfony JSON Schema Validation bundle. It covers how to install dependencies, start development, build static files, and deploy the documentation on various platforms.
- [API Reference | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/api.html): The API Reference section details the functionality of the Symfony JSON Schema Validation bundle's attributes, interfaces, and filters. This guide helps developers understand how to utilize these components for robust data validation in their applications.
- [Configuration | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/configuration.html): This page details the configuration options available for the Symfony JSON Schema Validation bundle. It covers how to configure the location of your JSON Schema files and set the base URL for external schema references.
- [DTO Injection | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/dto-injection.html): The 'DTO Injection' section explains how to use custom Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) with the bundle to ensure type-safe access to validated request data. It covers basic DTO usage, nested DTOs, and handling arrays with typed properties.
- [Examples | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/examples.html): This page presents real-world examples of using Symfony JSON Schema Validation to build APIs. The examples demonstrate how to use the bundle's controllers and schemas for user registration and product search.
- [How It Works | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/how-it-works.html): The 'How It Works' section explains the core philosophy of this bundle, which is to rely on a single JSON Schema as the source of truth for API contracts. This ensures that validation rules are consistent with documentation and prevents discrepancies between them.
- [Installation | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/installation.html): This documentation provides installation instructions for the 'outcomer/symfony-json-schema-validation' bundle. It covers requirements, registration, configuration options, and how to verify the installation.
- [OpenAPI Integration | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/openapi-integration.html): The 'outcomer/symfony-json-schema-validation' bundle seamlessly integrates with 'nelmio/api-doc-bundle' to automatically generate OpenAPI documentation from JSON Schemas. This ensures a single source of truth for validation and documentation, eliminating potential discrepancies between the two.
- [Quick Start | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/quick-start.html): This page provides a concise introduction to JSON Schema validation using the Outcomer bundle. It guides users through creating their first schema and demonstrates how to use it for validating user registration data.
- [Schema Basics | JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/guide/schema-basics.html): The guide delves into the core principles of JSON Schema, emphasizing its adherence to the official specification. It also explains how the bundle leverages the robust Opis JSON Schema library for validation, highlighting features like conditional schemas and filters for dynamic validations.
- [JSON Schema Validation](https://outcomer.github.io/symfony-json-schema-validation/): This page provides documentation on how to use Symfony's JSON Schema validation bundle for robust request validation. It covers the benefits of type-safe validation and automatic OpenAPI documentation generation using industry-standard JSON Schema.
